channel.title: The Gospel Coalition - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Gospel Coalition (thegospelcoalition.org)

item.title: Challenges Facing the Protestant Church (Part 2)
item.description: Brett McCracken leads a panel discussion with Brad Edwards, Gavin Ortlund, and Jared C. Wilson on practical responses to the challenges facing the church.

item.title: Struggling with Prayer? Ask God for Help.
item.description: When we struggle with prayer, the best place to start isn’t finding a new note-card system or journal—it’s admitting our struggle to God and asking him to help us pray.

item.title: Phones in the Pews: Threat or Discipleship Opportunity?
item.description: How can we shepherd our people to receive the preached Word with humility amid a culture where instant verification has become instinctive?

item.title: Why Pastoral Ministry Is Worth Pursuing Today
item.description: Paul reminds us that those considering pastoral ministry must think neither too little nor too much of this calling.

item.title: Does Work-from-Home Mean Work-Without-Rest?
item.description: We don’t have to finish everything now, because Christ will finish everything then.

item.title: Union with Christ: The Most Underrated Doctrine (with Sam Allberry)
item.description: What is true of Christ becomes true of us. Matt Smethurst and Ligon Duncan are joined by Sam Allberry to discuss how pastors can recover the often overlooked doctrine of union with Christ and share it with their congregations.

item.title: How My Brain Injury Prepared Me for the AI Revolution
item.description: After a brain injury nearly took my life, I learned what really gives human life value—and how humans are fundamentally different from AI.

item.title: Perfect Pitch Is Not a Fruit of the Spirit
item.description: ‘Spirit-Filled Singing’ reminds us that faithful worship is measured not by what we produce on a stage but by the kind of people we’re becoming together before God.

item.title: New Research Confirms Jesus’s Miracles
item.description: While Josephus isn’t sure of the source for Jesus’s supernatural deeds, he is sure they happened.

item.title: Reading Romans 7 with John Newton
item.description: According to Newton, Paul’s total inability is the context within which the Lord makes the sufficiency of his own power and grace known to Paul.
